gdpPerCapita.description: GDP per capita, current US$ (nominal, not PPP-adjusted).
gdpPerCapita.units: current US$ per person per year

gini.description: Gini index, World Bank estimate (household survey based; not annual for every country).

governance.description: Worldwide Governance Indicators (WGI) - Government Effectiveness estimate. Approx. -2.5 (weak) to +2.5 (strong); NOT the same 0-1 scale as constants.ts `governance`, so this field is compared by rank correlation, not by ratio or level.
governance.units: WGI governance estimate, approx. -2.5 to +2.5 (standard normal units)
